BLOODBATH! CHICKENS WIN LOW-SCORING WEEK 3; 
ROUGHRIDERS GROW PFPI SEASON LEAD TO 2 GAMES

Mike’s Chickens win a low-scoring PFPI Week 3 – the only team above .500 with a 9-7 mark. Dick’s Roughriders grow his season lead to 2 games over the Chickens, Tati’s Llamas and Christie’s Ferraris in a triple knot in second place.

The Llamas cashed the week’s only Unique Hit with a Coonskin for Commanders over Seahawks.

And PFPI’s 23rd season of the modern era digs in – now three weeks down and 15 to go in the marathon run for the Dad’s Dynamics Championship Trophy.
